title: Transport Barrel
summary: Ogre-tossed barrel used to carry a goblin past defenses.

fields.Encounter: An Ogre Brute can throw this barrel as a goblin transport.
fields.Durability: 12 HP. Resists Piercing, is vulnerable to Bludgeoning and Fire, and is immune to Poison and Psychic. Weighs about 90 lb.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
